text:
Maya: Heads-up 1: want to spin up a small community push around a new "reference-kit" repo: 1) short launch post, 2) a live hands-on "build along" webinar, 3) partner cross-posts. Aim: contributors + signups. Thoughts?

Connor: +1. prefer a 45m format: 20m demo, 15m hands-on lab, 10m live Q&A. Make sure repo has a one-file quickstart for the first 10 minutes.

Lee: For the repo: add `quickstart.sh` that gets an environment up in 5-7 minutes (cpu fallback). Also include a tiny example prompt set under `examples/workshop`. I'll sketch the script tonight.

Zuri: partner outreach idea 1: ask two orgs to co-promote and co-host a 10-min segment. I can ping @open-ml-community and @edge-deploy. They usually help amplify.

Nina: landing page / registration flow: we should use a lightweight form (no heavy gating). Put a hidden utm: `utm_campaign=refkit_launch_2026`. Add a checkbox for "want an enterprise trial" -> tag for sales.

Maya: messaging note: for the blog lead, let's highlight reproducible benchmarking and a "performance badge" people can run locally to compare setups. Quick hook: "Reference-kit: reproducible inference for teams building with LLMs."

Connor: benchmark narrative owner? we need a short method section: p50/p95, test payload (100 tokens), batching off vs batching on, cost delta using quantized model. Also mention fallbacks and routing.

Lee: I'll add `bench/run_bench.sh` and a README with config presets. Include a tiny plot generator (matplotlib) so marketing can take screenshots.

Nina: promotional plan: blog + GH release Mon -> webinar Thurs -> community threads Fri. Also plan an email to dev trialers with an invite. We'll set an audience for ad retargeting.

Maya: can growth route webinar leads 2 ways: if "enterprise trial" checked -> AE queue; else -> dev-rel nurture. Use HS form field `enterprise_interest`.

Zuri: we should create a co-marketing brief for partners: one-sheeter, tweet copy, short demo clip (30s). I can draft the brief and share a Slack PM.

Connor: quick workshop snippet to show during hands-on (add to README):

# quick run
bash quickstart.sh && python3 demo/run_request.py --prompt "Summarize this article"

Lee: will add that and ensure demo runs with a tiny echo model fallback.

Maya: content owners checklist:
- Quickstart + examples -> Lee
- Benchmark scripts + plot -> Lee + Connor
- Blog draft -> Maya + Nina
- Webinar runbook + slides -> Zuri
- Partner outreach + brief -> Zuri
- HubSpot form + routing -> Nina

buildbot: Reminder: deploy preview available at https://deploy-preview.redwood.com/refkit (expires in 48h).

Lee: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/reference-kit/pull/101 1 includes quickstart, examples, bench script. Tagging @Maya @Connor.

Nina: HS form created: form_id `hs_refkit_launch_026`. Routing rule: if `enterprise_interest=true` -> AE_POOL_ENTERPRISE else -> DEVREL_SEQ. Will add hidden utm mapping.

Connor: for the webinar, let's record the bench runs live and show how changing batch size affects p95. Audience will like the tangible numbers.

Zuri: rehearsal slots: Tue 3pm or Wed 9am. I'll book Tue 3pm.

Maya: copy ideas for social (short):
- "Reference-kit: a reproducible starter for running inference and validating perf. Join our live workshop. RSVP -> <https://events.redwood.com/refkit>"
- "Run our 2-min perf badge and compare models. See results in our launch post. -> <https://github.com/redwood-inference/reference-kit>"

Nina: follow-up flow: send recording + quick contributor guide + link to PRs labeled `good-first-issue`. Also include a short survey about Dedicated/Private interest.

Lee: PR merged to main (just now). Will start a small bench run and post results.

Connor: I'll draft the benchmark blurb for the blog: include instance types, quantization setting, and cost per 1k tokens. Keep the numbers before the narrative so devs can scan.

Maya: thanks team. Let's reconvene here after the rehearsal for final signoff. :raised_hands:

Zuri: co-marketing brief draft posted: https://docs.google.com/draft/refkit-partner-brief. Pinged partners.

buildbot: Webinar event scheduled: "Reference-kit Workshop" Thu Apr 29 11:00 PDT. Registration: <https://events.redwood.com/refkit>.

Nina: analytics: I'll add UTM tracking and an event label `refkit_launch_2026` for all channels.

Maya: perfect. closing loop: final blog + release on Mon; webinar Thurs; partner threads Fri.
